Body Clock's Impact on Mental Health Explored

The relationship between an individual's biological clock, also known as the circadian rhythm, and mental health, particularly depression, is being examined. The News Minute and The Globe and Mail report on how disruptions to the body clock can affect mental well-being and suggest methods for maintaining its synchronization.
